after.manufacturerDetails:
Description 
FORK BAG / 01 is a fork bag for bikepackers who need additional volume outside the frame without compromising aerodynamics. Its signature is the flat, wedge-shaped design, keeping it sleek and aero. Combined with a low center of gravity, handling remains balanced and natural. A stable internal structure prevents bulging, even when using the full 3.1‑liter capacity. A weatherproof zipper gives access to the main compartment, plus a mesh quick-access pocket for short stops on the go. The FORK BAG / 01 mounts via a quick, uncomplicated and reliable locking mechanism – either directly to existing fork mounts (threaded bosses) or, on rigid and suspension forks without mounts, via thru axles on the bike. For thru-axle mounting, an appropriate adapter solution such as the Old Man Mountain Axle Pack is required. Both mounting options are twist- and slip-resistant. FORK BAG / 01 can be purchased as a single bag for the right or left side, or as a set for both sides.
Thanks to our proprietary LiteGrid-RN200T3 material, FORK BAG / 01 is ultralight, robust and weatherproof. We combine two nylon yarn strengths using a special weaving technique into a ripstop fabric that is then coated on both sides and high-frequency welded. The result is the perfect balance of lightness and stability – for weatherproof products that are easy to clean.
Compatibility 
The FORK BAG / 01 fits all forks with at least two threaded bushings per fork leg, spaced at the standard 64 mm interval. Rigid and suspension forks without threaded bushings require an additional compatible mount, such as the Axle Pack from Old Man Mountain.
For optimal riding stability, we recommend using two FORK BAGS with balanced weight distribution. The maximum load per bag is 3 kg.

after.manufacturerDetails:
Beschreibung 
FULL FRAME BAG / 02 Made to fit your frame precisely. Bikepackers and lovers of long adventures know: millimeters matter. Driven by this need – to use every angle to its full potential – we manufacture the FULL FRAME BAG / 02 as an individual piece in Germany, even made to measure. It fills your main triangle to the maximum and is therefore our frame bag with the greatest possible capacity.
The frame bag is ideal for long tours or for bikepackers who want to store their gear as centrally as possible on the bike. Your kit is safely stowed in two large main compartments that can also be combined into one. Thoughtful details such as the slim side pocket, the covered cable and hydration hose exit, the waterproof zippers and the reflectors turn this ultralight, robust bag into a travel one-off.
Note: This bag is produced in highly limited quantities in monthly “drops”. If it is currently unavailable, we recommend joining the waitlist to secure the next drop. 
Thanks to our proprietary LiteGrid-RN200T3 material, FULL FRAME BAG / 02 is ultralight, robust and weatherproof. We combine two nylon yarn strengths using a special weaving technique into a ripstop fabric that is then coated on both sides, stitched and taped. The result is the perfect balance of lightness and stability – for weatherproof products that are easy to clean.
Ordering & delivery process 
1. After your order, we send you a kit to create a frame template, including all required information and a prepaid envelope for returning the completed template to us.
2. Once we receive your template, we start production. Please expect a 3–4 week lead time.
3. You receive your custom-made frame bag – and the adventures can begin.
The FULL FRAME BAG is custom-made according to your measurements. Therefore, pursuant to Section 312g (2) No. 1 of the German Civil Code (BGB), there is no right of withdrawal. 
Kompatibilität 
The FULL FRAME BAG / 02 is individually adapted and custom-made to the specific frame size and geometry by creating a template in advance. For this reason, the bag is only compatible with the specific frame it was made for.
Depending on your preference, the bag can be made in a width of 5 cm or 6 cm. We will ask for your preferred width after the order, when the template is created.
Note: Due to the complex geometry inside the frame triangle, especially around the rear shock, we cannot produce FULL FRAME BAGs for full-suspension MTBs.

Description 
The SADDLE BAG / 02 is a classic among bikepacking bags. It allows you to carry a significant amount of gear in the rider's slipstream. However, such bags typically tend to swing from side to side, especially when standing and pedaling. Therefore, we paid particular attention to its stable attachment. Using aluminum hooks and a robust strap system, the bag is individually secured to each saddle rail. Thanks to the central carbon fiber strip, this creates a very stable, ultra-lightweight storage compartment. For more rigid packing with the roll-top closure, the bag features a valve for air release. Additional equipment can be secured under elastic straps on the top. Mounting points for a rear light are also included. The SADDLE BAG / 02 is especially suitable for carrying items you don't necessarily need access to while riding, such as a sleeping bag, toiletries, and a change of clothes.

Description 
The TOP TUBE BAG / 03 is the next generation of our most popular bag. The large opening with a flap closure and magnetic fastener, offering easy access and a clear view of the contents, remains the central, unique feature of this version. The front strap design has been further developed: the hook and loop strap is now replaceable and extendable – making it compatible with integrated handlebars. As before, the bottom of the bag features light padding to securely transport smartphones or other electronics, even on rough rides. The reinforced sides and slightly reduced width of the bag prevent contact with the thighs, even during extremely sporty riding. Last but not least, the TOP TUBE BAG / 03 is bolt-on ready and can be screwed directly to the frame without the included hook and loop straps. This makes it the ideal solution for carrying snacks and gear that you want to access quickly while riding.
TOP TUBE BAG / 03 is ultralight, robust, and weatherproof thanks to our specially developed LiteGrid-RN200T3 material. We combine two different thicknesses of nylon using a special weaving technique to create a ripstop fabric, which is then coated on both sides and high-frequency welded. This results in the perfect symbiosis of lightness and stability – for weatherproof products that are easy to clean.

TOP TUBE BAG / 03 passt an alle Fahrräder, die ein Oberrohr besitzen und kann hinter das Steuerrohr oder vor die Sattelstütze montiert werden (oder beides, wenn man zwei davon verwendet). Die Tasche kann optional auch aufs Oberrohr geschraubt werden, wenn der Rahmen dafür vorbereitet ist (Löcher vorhanden).
